decisive_items: compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery
Doppler ultrasonography of the left lower extremity demonstrated extensive deep vein thrombosis
filling defect in the dilated, nonenhancing left common iliac vein
response.rationale: The CT finding of left common iliac vein compression by the right common iliac artery is the specific cause of the patient's extensive left-sided DVT, making May-Thurner syndrome the unifying diagnosis. DVT is present but is a downstream consequence rather than the underlying syndrome.

rejected.why: Deep vein thrombosis is confirmed but is the thrombotic complication of the underlying left common iliac vein compression, not the most specific or complete diagnosis.
